note: lap 11 screen rule (lap 10's), fixed at gate screen-specs (before any screen build). Per request R: Q = mean over the k builds of R-cc-p of the pass fractions on R-cc-p and on R-cx-p, averaged (both families' scenarios weigh the same); a set a build has no results for counts 0; scenarios listed in screen-errors.json (written at gate main under the errors rule, approved by the owner) are left out. R is in the band when floorPct <= Q < ceilingPct. Up to maxRequests requests in the band go on to the main runs, lowest Q first; ties: the order below. The screen's drafts and builds are never used in the main analysis. Names resolve to the last redraft. Rules: laps/lap-11/runbook.md.
errorsRule: Errors rule (lap 8, plus lap 11): an expected value that contradicts the request, or an amount, date or count that does not add up, is an expectation error; so is a set step (a service step POST /responses) whose answer contradicts the request's service API (a method or path the API does not have, or a status, body or header it does not give for that method and path; an answer the request's own catch-all line covers, such as an unlisted status handled like a 5xx, does not contradict it), each with a quote of the request.
